characterization_methods.key_findings: The worn surface shows (Fe,Mn)₃AlC (κ-carbide particle), broken coarse κ, and microcracking propagating along the broken coarse κ particle.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Higher-magnification SEM worn surface annotated '1050°C+550°C(4h)'; 2.5 µm scale bar
characterization_methods.purpose: Detailed observation of the lamination region / worn surface to detect broken coarse κ particles and microcracking.

defect_interactions.interaction_type: crack initiation and microcrack propagation along broken coarse κ particles
defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: In the lamination region of the 550 °C annealed for 4 h sample, the propagation of microcracks is detected along the broken coarse κ particles, indicating that the overaged κ particles are the initiation of cracks, delamination, and other irreparable damages.

interfaces.phase_evolution: κ particles coarsen around grain boundaries after overaging (longer than 2 h at 550 °C).

service_conditions.environment: wear test (tribological); worn surface and lamination region examined by SEM

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: This 4 h treatment is an overaging condition (longer than 2 h at 550 °C) that coarsens κ particles around the grain boundaries.

defects.type: microcracking along broken coarse κ-carbide particles

phases_present.morphology: coarse particles around the grain boundaries

structures.overall_structure: Austenite matrix with coarse κ-carbide ((Fe,Mn)₃AlC) particles around the grain boundaries after 1050 °C quenching + 550 °C / 4 h overaging; in the worn-surface lamination region, broken coarse κ particles are associated with microcracking.

unmapped_findings: [b0080] The wear rate of Fe–28Mn–1C–8.5Al (wt%) low-density steel deteriorated after overaging treatment with longer than 2 h at 550 °C due to the coarsened κ particles around the grain boundaries.

[b0080] In the 550 °C annealed for 4 h sample, the propagation of microcracks is detected along the broken coarse κ particles in the lamination region, indicating that the overaged κ particles are the initiation of cracks, delamination, and other irreparable damages.

[figure_008] In the SEM worn surface annotated '1050°C+550°C(4h)' (2.5 µm scale bar), labels mark (Fe,Mn)₃AlC (κ-carbide particle), broken coarse κ, and microcracking propagating along the broken coarse κ particle.
